messages.content: Thank you for meeting with me today. To start, I would like to understand the high-level goals for enhancing the university student portal. What specific outcomes or improvements are you hoping to achieve with the new features of personalised timetable management, automated grade notifications, and structured module feedback?

Yeah, thanks for having me. Honestly, I just want the portal to be easier to use. Like, my timetable is a bit of a mess, and I wish I could make it clearer, you know? Maybe colour-code things or hide classes that are cancelled. 

And it would be super helpful to get a notification when my grades are out. I never want to miss that. 

Also, giving feedback on modules should be easier, so we can actually say what's working and what's not. That's about it, really.

Thank you for sharing your thoughts. It sounds like you’re looking for a more user-friendly experience with the portal. To clarify, when you mention wanting a clearer timetable, are you specifically looking for features such as colour-coding for different types of classes or the ability to filter out cancelled classes? Could you elaborate on what you envision for this personalised timetable management?

Yeah, exactly! I think colour-coding would help a lot. Like, if I could use different colours for lectures, labs, and study time, that would make it way easier to see. And being able to hide classes that are cancelled would be great too, so I’m not looking at stuff I don’t need to worry about. 

Also, maybe if I could add in my own study blocks, that would help me organise my time better. Just something to make it clearer, you know?

I understand now. So, for the personalised timetable management, you’d like to have features that allow you to colour-code different types of classes, hide cancelled classes, and add your own study blocks to better organise your time. 

To ensure we capture all your needs, can you explain how you would like the notifications for grades to work? Specifically, what kind of notifications do you think would be most helpful for you?

Yeah, for the grade notifications, I just want to know as soon as a grade gets posted. Like, if I could get a message or something right away, that would be awesome. I don't want to keep checking all the time. Just a quick pop-up or an email would work. I just want to be in the loop without having to stress about it, you know?

Thank you for that clarification. So, for the automated grade notifications, you would like to receive immediate alerts—either through a pop-up notification on the portal or via email—whenever a new grade is posted. This way, you can stay informed without the need to constantly check for updates.

Now, regarding the structured module feedback system, could you describe how you envision this feature? What specific elements would you like to include in the feedback process to make it easier for students to express their thoughts on modules?

Sure! I think it should be super easy to give feedback after the classes are done. Like, maybe a simple form where we can quickly rate things, like how the content was and how the teaching went. 

Just something straightforward, you know? I don’t want to write a whole essay or anything. Also, it should be easy for us to share what resources were helpful or not. I think that would really help improve the modules if we could just say what we thought.

That makes a lot of sense. For the structured module feedback system, you would prefer a straightforward form that allows you to quickly rate aspects such as the content and teaching quality after classes. Additionally, you’d like the option to share which resources were helpful or not, without requiring lengthy written responses. 

To summarise what we have so far:

1. Personalised timetable management with features for colour-coding different class types, hiding cancelled classes, and adding custom study blocks.
2. Automated grade notifications that alert you immediately via pop-up or email when a new grade is posted.
3. A structured module feedback system with a simple form for rating content and teaching, along with the ability to share feedback on helpful resources.

Before we conclude, are there any limitations or restrictions you foresee regarding these enhancements, such as technical constraints or user access issues?

Um, I haven't really thought about any limitations or technical stuff like that. I just want these features to work well and make things easier for us. I guess it just has to fit into the current portal? But honestly, I’m not sure about any of that. I just hope it can be done without too many headaches!

I appreciate your input. It sounds like your main concern is that the new features should integrate smoothly with the existing portal infrastructure without causing complications. 

To summarise our discussion and the requirements gathered:

1. **Personalised Timetable Management**: Features allowing colour-coding for different class types, hiding of cancelled classes, and the ability to add custom study blocks.
2. **Automated Grade Notifications**: Immediate alerts via pop-up or email when new grades are posted, to keep students informed without constant checking.
3. **Structured Module Feedback System**: A simple feedback form that allows quick ratings of content and teaching quality, along with the ability to share feedback on helpful resources.

It appears we have sufficient detail on these enhancements. If I understand correctly, your primary aim is to enhance the usability of the portal while ensuring these features fit within the current system. 

Thank you for your time and insights today.
